What is ttf-ia-writer?

This package bundles iA Writer's own font families, iA Writer Mono, iA Writer Duo, and iA Writer Quattro, derived from IBM's Plex typeface family and tuned for distraction-free writing. They are the same fonts iA ships in its iA Writer apps across Mac, Windows, iOS, iPadOS, and Android, released here so anyone can install and use them system-wide.

Install ttf-ia-writer on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add ttf-ia-writer

Good to know

  • No special requirements documented.
